message: 友達未満恋人以上
After school--
The air in the Student Council room is stagnant in one particular spot.
Ever since she was made a fool of at Prier, Misa hasn't been able to swallow her anger.

name: Ria
message: 「M-Misa-chan, would you like some black tea? It'll help calm you down.」

name: Misa
message: 「Thank you very much, I'll gladly have some.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, Nanaka-san! This is scalding hot!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, duh, if you chug freshly brewed tea in one gulp! And more importantly, don't yell at me!」

name: Misa
message: 「Grrr--! I am NOT yelling!」

name: Synn
message: 「This looks like a job for Paqy. Use that cuteness of yours to melt Misa's heart.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Leave her be, leave her be.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Leave her be... hotcakes.\s07」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, it's a message arrow from Jiiya.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm, let's see... 'Understood. I shall prepare hotcakes for tomorrow's breakfast,' it says. Yay, yay♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, Paqy, do me a favor.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You just don't get it. Hissy's on 'that time of the month'--give her two or three days and she'll be back to normal.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, Helena-san told me to let Pasta run free for now...」

name: Synn
message: 「Then again, if we leave Misa like this, it's going to interfere with Student Council business...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Despite how she looks, Misa's actually super capable, after all. Nobody else could fill in for her.」

name: Ria
message: 「I wonder why she's this mad?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If you ask me, it's because someone pointed out the fact that she's in a total man-drought and a chronic masturbator. There's no doubt about it.」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha!?!!」

name: Synn
message: 「What's a 'man drought'?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Okay, that's just harsh. Even Hisu doesn't get talked about like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really get it, but it sounds pretty awful.」

name: Ria
message: 「Phew, as a senior I'd like to do something about this, but it's probably best to rely on someone with more experience for this kind of thing.」

name: Helena
message: 「You rang?」

name: Helena
message: 「'I know how to calm things down. Leave it to me'」

name: Ria
message: 「...Lolotte, could you ask Riesling-san if he has any suggestions?」

name: Helena
message: 「Heehee. Choosing to flat-out ignore me--you've grown up, Ria.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wah!? F-Fire! Over there, over there, outside the window!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? No it isn't, Treasurer. Those are Grandpa's smoke signals. Can't you tell just by looking?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How the heck would anyone know that?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm, hmm... Senior, Grandpa says, 'Then, via a peaceful resolution using a pistol, I shall execute Lady Pasta--'」

name: Ria
message: 「Absolutely not!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「More importantly, how the hell does that butler know what we're talking about in here?」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, calm down.」

name: Misa
message: 「How am I supposed to stay calm about this!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then you don't have to calm down.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I'll calm down if I want to!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Jeez, what is going on here.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Basically, Misa's just sore about losing to Pasta and wants to get back at her, right?」

name: Helena
message: 「Exactly! Misa just needs to get herself a boyfriend too so she can feel vindicated.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I see...!」

name: Ria
message: 「Sis! You mustn't decide on someone who might become your future partner with that kind of mindset!」

name: Helena
message: 「Jeez, you're so uptight. Even though your boobs are so soft.」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Stop it... ugh, ah~n!」

name: Misa
message: 「You don't actually have to date them for real.」

name: Misa
message: 「Let's have someone pretend to be my boyfriend and act like we're dating right in front of Pasta-san.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's an option, I guess...」

name: Synn
message: 「You make it sound easy, though, isn't that tough? Misa, have you ever... well, with a guy...」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Have you ever gotten lovey-dovey with one?」

name: Misa
message: 「Nwah!?」

name: Misa
message: 「O-Of course I have! Don't treat me like an idiot!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, so you have.」

name: Misa
message: 「Kieee!! What's your deal, what's your deal!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, ngh... e-everyone, don't just casually brush this off. Please stop my sister!」

name: Helena
message: 「Aw, don't be so mean~. Is it this boob saying things it doesn't really mean like 'stop it'? Or is it this boob~?」

name: Ria
message: 「Boobs don't talk!」

name: Helena
message: 「Ria, if you decide something is impossible right from the start, you'll never accomplish anything.」

name: Helena
message: 「Even if they can't now, if I believe in miracles and keep kneading them, they might turn into talking boobs someday!」

name: Ria
message: 「No they won't!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Actually, the guidebook says the exact same thing as the Chairwoman, you know?」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Synn-kun, don't look over here... bad!」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu\s04, it's still a bit too early for Synn-chan, isn't it.」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I'll keep my sister distracted, so... s-so, Synn-kun, you and the others keep... k-keep the meeting going...」

name: Ria
message: 「Uaaah~~」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is this really okay?」

name: Misa
message: 「We can't let Onee-sama's dying wish go to waste.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ria-chan's still alive, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「For the sake of Senpai, who's putting herself on the line to protect us, let's pass the resolution as fast as we can!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So then, who are we gonna ask to play the boyfriend? Which class, and who?」

name: Misa
message: 「It doesn't necessarily have to be a boy. Having a girl cross-dress will suffice.」

name: Misa
message: 「It's hard to ask an outsider... which means it'll have to be someone affiliated with the Student Council.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh, I'd love to do it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte? If it were you, it'd probably go something like this, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Baby, falling for me is like throwing water on a hot stone.」

name: Misa
message: 「Rejected.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hic... Can I not be of any help?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There, there, your spirit was admirable, Lolo-chan.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right--Nanaka's quick to pick a fight, takes good care of others, and has a strong sense of chivalry. She's the perfect fit for the boyfriend role.」

name: Synn
message: 「If it's Nanaka--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You blockhead! Who the hell dumps all the condiments in at once?! You're gonna wipe out the flavor of the broth!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh, whaddaya say?! You call yourself a soba connoisseur and you've never even seen a buckwheat flower?! Why I oughta, you idiot, you darn fool!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, it'd probably go something like that.」

name: Misa
message: 「Out of the question. That wouldn't even pass as a conversation between lovers.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't go fantasizing on your own and then rejecting me for it!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How about Jiiya? He's taller than the Vice President, so he'd be a perfect fit for the gentleman's role.」

name: Misa
message: 「Let's see...」

name: Riesling
message: 「When it comes to romantic relationships between men and women, please engrave the following three points onto your heart.」

name: Riesling
message: 「To incapacitate the target via shock, inflict permanent damage, and induce massive hemorrhaging.」

name: Riesling
message: 「In other words, the targets are the brain and the heart.」

name: Misa
message: 「...Let's have Riesling protect Lolotte-san rather than us.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, please leave securing my personal safety to that butler, my grandpa.」

name: Synn
message: 「If we're choosing based on height, who else is there?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, hey, why don't you use your perks, Misa, and ask Ria-senpai?」

name: Misa
message: 「N-No way, not that! Onee-sama is wonderful just the way she is! Dressing as a man is completely out of the question.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then what about Senpai's senpai, Helena-san? She's basically the final boss of the Student Council, so wouldn't she be easy to ask?」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san...」

name: Helena
message: 「Get lost. I've got no business with brats who still smell like milk.」

name: Helena
message: 「If you still wanna become a woman... become one in my arms.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-So embarrassing!」

name: Misa
message: 「Haaah~♪ That might actually be kinda wonderful. Expected nothing less from Onee-sama's onee-sama.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Misa's tastes are...」

name: Synn
message: 「Then it's decided--we'll ask Helena-san.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, going on a lil' date with me?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, how does this proposal sound to you?」

name: Helena
message: 「No way.」

name: Misa
message: 「Nngh... Are you dissatisfied with me playing the girlfriend role?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yep♪」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Why are you glaring at me?」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, Misa-chan isn't bad either, but... are you prepared? You'll end up like this, you know?」

name: Ria
message: 「Hah, hah, hah... ah... ugh! Uuuh~」

name: Paqy
message: 「R-Ria's totally wiped out and looking wild over there!?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I must respectfully decline.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, my? If you're going to climb the stairs to adulthood, I'm always happy to lay a hand--ahem, lend a hand, you know~」

name: Misa
message: 「No thank you. I can climb them all by myself!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Impressive as always, Madam Vice President, so good at doing it solo. Clap, clap, clap.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I get it, 'good at doing it solo' means doing step aerobics, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「No it doesn't!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Honestly, how shallow can my pool of connections get? At this rate, I'll have no choice but to ask some random boy from class.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, Misa with someone from the class next door...」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um, would I not be good enough?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Wait a second, Synn. Why are you suddenly saying--」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not sudden. It's by process of elimination, sure, but among the Student Council members, I'm the only one left.」

name: Misa
message: 「Come to think of it, wasn't Sakura-kun a Student Council officer too...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Believe it or not, I'm the President!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, I suppose it can't be helped. Under the circumstances, you'll do.」

name: Synn
message: 「Really!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Only because I have no choice, no choice!! Don't get the wrong idea.」

name: Misa
message: 「Now, once that's settled, let's march right into Prier!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh... n-no way... the two of them...!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hawa-hawa, how exciting♪ I'm tagging along too~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Me too! Y-You hear me, Synn? This is strictly just an act, okay!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「What're ya getting all worked up over, what about the soba?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up! We're charging in as soon as Ria-senpai recovers!」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I'm fine... L-Let's go, everyone.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oka~y.\s07」

name: Misa
message: 「All riiight!! Let's get fired up!」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「Excuse uuuus!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Is this how you enter a shop when you're on a date?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What's your problem! It's only because Sakura-kun isn't taking the lead for me!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nya is it? Thought we had customers, and it's just the usual broke losers, nya.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Lunch service is over, nya. Go wash your face in boiling water and come back tomorrow at noon, nya.」

name: Misa
message: 「Ohohoho, pardon our intrusion.」

name: Misa
message: 「We have not come for a meal today, you see--my boyfriend and I are simply here to partake in some tea.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyanuh? Your boyfriend? This guy? *Staaaare*」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, he's sizing me up like I'm super shady...」

name: Misa
message: 「Prepare a table for us. Might we trouble you for a high tea set?」

name: Pasta
message: 「High tea?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Oh, you mean that thing where you slop a bunch of tiny cakes and scones onto a plate as snacks for tea or coffee, with cream and fruit plopped all over, nya?」

name: Pasta
message: 「The calories alone are god-of-destruction tier, nya. Anyone who actually enjoys eating that garbage is gonna turn into a pig, nya.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I won't forgive anyone who insults sweets like that!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nya? Someone else is here too, nya?」

name: Ria
message: 「Nanaka-chan, calm down, calm down.」

name: Pasta
message: 「I'll bring it out for ya, so get your cold hard cash ready and go chat over there or whatever, nya.」

name: Misa
message: 「Now then, shall we go, darling.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, honey.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, calm down! You're walking with your right arm and right leg moving at the same time!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, Sakura-kun, pull yourself together!」

name: Synn
message: 「B-Because you marched straight here without us even practicing acting like a couple, Misa...」

name: Synn
message: 「You have experience with this, right, Misa? What's a guy supposed to do at a time like this?」

name: Misa
message: 「Eh... Eeeh!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-You just act like a dandy, sexy, gorgeous boyfriend and engage in some noble, adventurous French talk.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're just stringing random buzzwords together!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Awawa, President, Vice President. Lovers are supposed to link arms~」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I know that. Like this, right.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ow-ow-ow! Uncle, uncle, uncle!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, Misa! That's an armpit armbar!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's Grandpa's shuriken. Oh, there's a letter attached.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm, hmm... It says, 'All joint locks are merely applied mechanics. Applying roughly 3 kg more force should result in a bone fracture'」

name: Misa
message: 「Got it, I'll give it a try.」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't get it! Don't try it!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Sorry to keep you waiting, nya... Wait, what are you doing, nya? Hurry up and take your seats, nya.」
Misa hurriedly pulls away from me. Saved. Another second and my arm would've been snapped right off.
I'd heard romance between a man and a woman is a matter of life and death, so that wasn't just an exaggeration....

name: Synn
message: 「Misa...」
Hmm, maybe I should go with 'ladies first' and act like a movie star?

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun? Why are you laying tissues on the chair?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, I know it's supposed to be a handkerchief, but I just used mine in the restroom...」

name: Pasta
message: 「How rude, nya! We clean properly here, nya, it won't get dirty if you just sit down normally, nya!」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Right.」
We take our seats. Pasta has finished serving. In movies and stuff, after sitting down, you snap your fingers to call the waiter, right?

name: Misa
message: 「Don't do something so ill-mannered!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Is it?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Did you call, nya?」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, she came over.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Since you said you were boyfriend and girlfriend, I was being considerate and leaving the two of you alone, so what do you want, nya?」

name: Synn
message: 「Barkeep, the usual.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Pasta isn't a barkeep, nya.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Besides, isn't your 'usual' stuff like water, toothpicks, or paper napkins, nya?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Misa
message: 「N-No! Something with more mood... r-right, bring us some alcohol!」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan, alcohol is... bad!」

name: Pasta
message: 「There's no way I can serve that kind of stuff on campus, nya. Just stick to kids' beer and fake champagne, nya.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then, we'll have that.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Got it, nya, wait a bit, nya.」

name: Synn
message: 「I can't keep the conversation going, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「Just chat super naturally, like we always do!」

name: Synn
message: 「N-Naturally, huh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, about that home gardening you're interested in, vegetables actually have compatibility, you see-if you plant strawberries next to daikon radishes--」

name: Misa
message: 「Wh-Whaat!?」

name: Ria
message: 「What are you blurting out, Synn-kun.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-See, playing the boyfriend is way too impossible for Synn...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aaah, nom♪ Mr. Sachertorte is delicious.\s07」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Lolo-chan forgot our original goal and is just enjoying afternoon tea...」

name: Pasta
message: 「I brought it for you, nya.」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, let's make a toast... Heh, here's looking at you, kid--with a traditional wedding cup.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Bwahahaha! There's no way Synn could ever hit on a girl!」

name: Pasta
message: 「...Are you two actually dating, nya?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm telling you, we're genuine, bona fide lovers!」

name: Misa
message: 「T-That's right! We even went on a honeymoon stay in Atami the other day!」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan, if you're going to say that, it's a pre-wedding trip.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Is that really true, nya~~」

name: Pasta
message: 「If you're boyfriend and girlfriend, you wouldn't just clink glasses--you'd share a drink mouth-to-mouth, nya. Why aren't you doing that, nya?」

name: Synn
message: 「What did you say!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-You're lying about that, right?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Pasta never lies, nya. I study the Human World day and night, nya.」

name: Pasta
message: 「In the Papua New Guinean sitcom 'Papa Is a Milkman,' the two lovers drink milk mouth-to-mouth, nya.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that so? The milkman is justice--the very order of this world. We have to abide by it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Idiot! That's obviously a total load of crap!」

name: Synn
message: 「*Gulp*」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Sakura-kun?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-W-W-What are you planning to do, Synn!?」

name: Misa
message: 「F-F-F-Fine, I get it... *gulp*」

name: Nanaka
message: 「E-Even Misa... N-No way?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Come on, come on, smooch~! Prove you're lovers, nya.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Awa-awa! The president's lips are all puckered up like an octopus!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No, you definitely can't do that! No, no, no!」

name: Ria
message: 「You're still way too young for this, Lolotte. There, sorry about that.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Waaah, Senpai, please don't cover my eyes.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There's no way Synn could do it. There's no way he could ever kiss someone!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Phew.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What is it!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyaa!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Synn, what's the meaning of this!? Why are you doing that to Misa!!」

name: Misa
message: 「S-S-S-Sakura-kun, let go! Please, stop! I want my first kiss to be on a hill overlooking the sea!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't get carried away! Hyaaaah!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Bwahaaah!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Aw, it all spilled out. What a waste...」

name: Misa
message: 「What's your deal!! Are you more upset about the drink than not getting to kiss me!?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyapupupupu, I knew you two weren't lovers, nya. That mouth-to-mouth stuff I told you earlier was total nonsense, nya.」

name: Misa
message: 「What did you say!? Didn't you say you never lie!!」

name: Pasta
message: 「That's right, nya. Pasta never lies, nya--I just make mistakes, nya.」

name: Misa
message: 「Grrrrrraaaaaah!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Either way, the two of you were completely exposed by that terrible acting.」
